description: Land Acquisition - Theliyagonna, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The document contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and location details. This falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions" as specified in the Land Gazette (Type 4) classification criteria.
